page_title: LAZ 3-1 VEN | Lazio v Venezia 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Nicholas Pierini (Venezia) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+4' Giorgio Altare (Venezia) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
90+4' There's an opportunity for Nicholas Pierini (Venezia) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+3' The resulting corner, taken by Nicholas Pierini (Venezia), comes to nothing.
90+2' Nicholas Pierini (Venezia) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. The ball goes out for a corner. Venezia can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle after Pedro (Lazio) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
89' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
87' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio) replacing Matteo Guendouzi.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Taty Castellanos.
86' Antonio Raimondo (Venezia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christian Gytkjaer.
86' It's time for a substitution. Nunzio Lella (Venezia) comes on in place of Magnus Kofod Andersen.
85' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
85' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Lazio get a corner.
85' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the right post!
84' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
81' 3 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Giorgio Altare (Venezia) puts the ball into his own net.
79' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Ivan Provedel.
77' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Tijjani Noslin will be replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
77' Substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replaces Mattia Zaccagni.
74' Domen Crnigoj (Venezia) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
72' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Francesco Zampano (Venezia) heads on.
71' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle as Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
71' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
70' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
70' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Domen Crnigoj (Venezia).
66' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
65' The substitution has been made. Matias Vecino (Lazio) has replaced Nicolo Rovella.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
61' Nicholas Pierini (Venezia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
60' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
59' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

57' Ambitious effort from Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
55' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) didn't hesitate to shoot from around the penalty spot and aimed towards the top of the net. Jesse Joronen was alert, made a superb save and parried the ball onto the bar.
53' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) replaces Richie Sagrado.
53' Substitution. Gaetano Oristanio did his best and is replaced by Nicholas Pierini (Venezia).
52' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sees a yellow card from Paride Tremolada after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

51' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
51' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Lazio win a corner.
49' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
48' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Referee Paride Tremolada blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+1' Superb touch by Adam Marusic (Lazio) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save! The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A great solo run by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Jesse Joronen.
44' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Jesse Joronen no chance!
43' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle after Marin Sverko (Venezia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Lazio are about to take a penalty!
40' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paride Tremolada has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
38' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
38' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Jesse Joronen (Venezia) leaps to collect the ball.
34' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' A yellow card for a tackle by Richie Sagrado (Venezia). Paride Tremolada doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jesse Joronen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
31' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.

30' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
29' A lofted cross from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
27' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
25' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared.

24' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
20' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
19' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
19' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
19' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) makes a strong challenge and Paride Tremolada blows for a foul.
17' Adam Marusic (Lazio) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
15' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Jesse Joronen is prepared and dives to thwart him.
14' Paride Tremolada blows his whistle for a foul after Alfred Duncan (Venezia) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' Richie Sagrado (Venezia) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
11' 1 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:1.
10' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jesse Joronen, who smothers the ball.
9' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
6' Paride Tremolada blows for a foul after Francesco Zampano (Venezia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
5' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Francesco Zampano (Venezia).
3' 0 - 1 Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
2' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Paride Tremolada signals a set piece.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Venezia will take the kick-off.
Paride Tremolada is introduced as the referee for today's match.
